sasha_fin: Heads-up: launching a controlled price experiment on the high-throughput SKU. Proposal: 5% price increase for treatment, 80/20 split (treatment/control) for new signups, and a self-serve grandfather opt-in for legacy customers via Console. Cohort link: https://drive.company/fin/experiments/sku-high-2026.csv

mike_ops: Quick ops notes: please exclude reserved and marketplace-linked contracts. Add a soft QPS cap for treatment customers at 70% of their historical peak for first 14 days. Also want an auto-fallback to previous pricing if billing delta >1.0% in a 24h window.

leo_product: Grandfather flow: customers with invoices before 2024-10-01 get an opt-in toggle in Console (default off). Sales can request batch opt-ins via ticket. Need to confirm audit trail.

anya_eng: Technical constraints: billing supports per-customer rate_override. We'll need a small Console change (toggle + tooltip) and a backfill job for credits if customers are moved to grandfather mid-period. Backfill policy = prorated current invoice only. Dry-run scheduled for 2026-04-08T04:00:00Z.

zara_sales: Sales asks that the Console show "grandfathered_until" date for each account, and that manual opt-ins from sales are logged with rep name. We'll prepare a short playbook.

billingbot: Snapshot coverage check: 97.5% of cohort covered. Missing snapshots: acct_611. Command: archive_check --id acct_611.

sasha_fin: On credits: finance prefers not to touch closed invoices. Any manual disputes go to RevOps for escalation. We'll document this in the publish note.

mike_ops: Routing plan: I'll post a draft in #eng-infra with QPS caps and Dedicated routing rules. Also recommending we limit treatment to accounts <8M tokens/mo to reduce blast radius.

anya_eng: We'll add boolean metadata fields: "grandfather_opt_in" and "grandfathered_until". ETA for Console patch + small API change = 4 business days. Backfill job will mark accounts without snapshots as MANUAL_REVIEW.

leo_product: Approvals needed: finance sign-off on credit policy, legal on message + TOS blurb, product + eng on feature work. Target signoff by Thu so we can publish Tue next week.

sasha_fin: Thanks all 44aa. Tagging @legal @revops. Final publish notes + email templates will be posted here once approved.

mike_ops: Noted. I'll add the capacity gating doc this afternoon.

zara_sales: We'll queue the FAQ and exception sheet.
